clean_context.traffic_rule: car ahead within max(25 m, 0.75 s) or behind within max(15 m, 0.40 s) for at least 10% of observed lap time

args.valid_green_lap_rule: complete green laps with less than 1.0 s on pit road, at least 98% racing-state exposure when SessionState exists, excluding the first green lap immediately after a caution, off-track laps, and laps with close traffic for at least 10% of observed time

pace.slope_exposure_definition: Sum of sampled green-time fractions over complete laps between retained pace observations; an exposure approximation, not physical green distance. Incomplete or missing intervening laps withhold the rate.

vehicle_dynamics.proxy_note: Wheel-speed divergence is a conservative tire-load proxy; corner-radius differences, banking, bumps, and sensor behavior can contribute.

tire_set_lifecycle.scope: session-local; initial pre-session tire history is unknown

damage_repair_context.scope_note: This screens only recorded pit/tow/repair evidence and never certifies that the car was fully undamaged; all normal clean-lap filters still apply.

args.segment_note: Segments are telemetry-derived load zones; cached track references may supply official corner names.

phase_definition.confirmed_model: chronological early/middle/late thirds of this run's eligible laps with exact per-tire green-lap-on-set bounds after every tire has a confirmed zero-age boundary
phase_definition.fallback_model: chronological early/middle/late thirds with session-relative age bounds when at least one tire lacks a confirmed zero-age boundary
phase_definition.tire_state_labels: fresh/settled/worn remain unavailable until session- or history-derived pace/control/tire change points support inclusive green-lap-age boundaries
phase_definition.late_semantics: older-set/late-run proxy when green-lap age is confirmed; late-run proxy otherwise; never measured worn tread state

eligibility.rule: complete clean green laps only; pit, caution/mixed, restart, non-racing-state, off-track, close-traffic, and partial laps are excluded when the required channels exist

brake_energy_proxy.definition: integral of brake fraction x vehicle speed through the zone

brake_onset_release.definition: 0.05 brake-fraction crossings; omitted when the transition is not observed

steering_amount_work.definition: mean absolute angle, sign-change corrections, and integral of absolute angle x speed, on the recording's steering basis (lap_traces.steering: road-wheel angle when the setup states the steering ratio)

turn_in.definition: first steering demand crossing 0.05 rad of steering-wheel angle (0.05/12 rad of road-wheel angle) above the pre-zone signed steering baseline; absolute-angle fallback when no baseline exists; omitted and boundary-censored when the crossing predates the analysis window

throttle_pickup_exit.definition: first 0.75 throttle sample after minimum speed plus zone-exit throttle

coaching.target_rule: no exact target without a valid aligned representative-lap comparison

initial_zero_evidence.rule: All four tire odometers must begin near zero and later demonstrate a reset in the same recording.

tire_age_basis.limitation: At least one tire lacks a confirmed zero-age boundary; early/middle/late are observational run phases, not proof of fresh or worn tires.

runs.new_set_confirmation_rule: all four tire ages are lifecycle-confirmed and the first eligible lap starts at no more than 0.25 green-lap equivalents
